# CLI reference

`agility-bridge` with no command (or `stdio`) serves MCP on stdin/stdout; `agility-bridge serve` runs the HTTP
server. The commands below manage a server: locally over its database (default) or remotely through the admin API
when `AB_ADMIN_URL` is set ([guide](../guide/cli.md)). Output is JSON on stdout. Secrets are never arguments.

## init

### `init`

Write a new master key (0600) to the user configuration directory, never overwriting one.

```text
agility-bridge init [--key-file <value>]
```

| Name | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--key-file` | string | Where to write it (default ~/.config/agility-bridge/master.key) |

Runs without a server.

## admin-token

### `admin-token`

Print a new break-glass admin token for AB_ADMIN_TOKEN_FILE (shown once).

```text
agility-bridge admin-token
```

Runs without a server.

## user

### `user list`

List users.

```text
agility-bridge user list
```

Local or remote.

### `user add`

Add a user.

```text
agility-bridge user add <email> [--role <value>] [--name <value>]
```

| Name | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `<email>` | argument | Email address |
| `--role` | string | `member` (default), `admin` or `owner` |
| `--name` | string | Display name |

Local or remote.

### `user set-role`

Change a user's role.

```text
agility-bridge user set-role <user-id> <role>
```

| Name | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `<user-id>` | argument | User id |
| `<role>` | argument | `member`, `admin` or `owner` |

Local or remote.

### `user disable`

Disable a user.

```text
agility-bridge user disable <user-id>
```

| Name | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `<user-id>` | argument | User id |

Local or remote.

## instance

### `instance list`

List Agility instances.

```text
agility-bridge instance list
```

Local or remote.

### `instance add`

Add an Agility instance.

```text
agility-bridge instance add <label> <url> [--ca-file <value>]
```

| Name | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `<label>` | argument | Name for it |
| `<url>` | argument | The address you open Agility at, e.g. https://www7.v1host.com/YourInstance |
| `--ca-file` | string | PEM bundle of a private CA (Node only) |

Local or remote.

### `instance retarget`

Change an instance's address or CA (owner; revokes its credentials and grants).

```text
agility-bridge instance retarget <instance-id> <url> [--ca-file <value>]
```

| Name | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `<instance-id>` | argument | Instance id |
| `<url>` | argument | The new address |
| `--ca-file` | string | PEM bundle of a private CA |

Local or remote.

### `instance delete`

Delete an unused instance.

```text
agility-bridge instance delete <instance-id>
```

| Name | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `<instance-id>` | argument | Instance id |

Local or remote.

## credential

### `credential list`

List credentials (never their tokens).

```text
agility-bridge credential list [--instance <value>]
```

| Name | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--instance` | string | Only this instance |

Local or remote.

### `credential add`

Store a shared Agility token (from --from-file, AB_AGILITY_TOKEN, standard input or a hidden prompt).

```text
agility-bridge credential add --instance <value> --label <value> [--from-file <value>]
```

| Name | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--instance` | string, required | Instance id |
| `--label` | string, required | Name, e.g. the service member |
| `--from-file` | string | Read the Agility token from this 0600 file |

Local or remote.

### `credential replace`

Replace a credential's token (it becomes unvalidated).

```text
agility-bridge credential replace <credential-id> [--from-file <value>]
```

| Name | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `<credential-id>` | argument | Credential id |
| `--from-file` | string | Read the Agility token from this 0600 file |

Local or remote.

### `credential validate`

Ask Agility now whose token it is and what it can reach.

```text
agility-bridge credential validate <credential-id>
```

| Name | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `<credential-id>` | argument | Credential id |

Local or remote.

### `credential revoke`

Revoke a credential.

```text
agility-bridge credential revoke <credential-id>
```

| Name | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `<credential-id>` | argument | Credential id |

Local or remote.

### `credential delete`

Delete an unused credential.

```text
agility-bridge credential delete <credential-id>
```

| Name | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `<credential-id>` | argument | Credential id |

Local or remote.

## workspace

### `workspace list`

List workspaces.

```text
agility-bridge workspace list
```

Local or remote.

### `workspace show`

Show a workspace.

```text
agility-bridge workspace show <workspace-id>
```

| Name | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `<workspace-id>` | argument | Workspace id |

Local or remote.

### `workspace add`

Create a workspace at /w/<slug>/mcp.

```text
agility-bridge workspace add <slug> --name <value> --instance <value> --project <value> [--children] [--default-credential <value>] [--tools a,b] [--asset-types-allow a,b] [--asset-types-deny a,b] [--max-rows <n>]
```

| Name | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `<slug>` | argument | URL name: lower-case letters, digits, hyphens |
| `--name` | string, required | Display name |
| `--instance` | string, required | Instance id |
| `--project` | string, repeatable, required | Allowed Agility project, Scope:<id> (repeat) |
| `--children` | flag | Include sub-projects |
| `--default-credential` | string | Shared credential for grants that name none |
| `--tools` | list | Enabled tools (default: every read tool) |
| `--asset-types-allow` | list | Only these asset types |
| `--asset-types-deny` | list | Never these asset types |
| `--max-rows` | int | Most rows per call |

Local or remote.

### `workspace set`

Change a workspace (only the options given).

```text
agility-bridge workspace set <workspace-id> [--name <value>] [--project <value>] [--default-credential <value>] [--tools a,b] [--max-rows <n>]
```

| Name | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `<workspace-id>` | argument | Workspace id |
| `--name` | string | Display name |
| `--project` | string, repeatable | Replace the allowed projects (repeat) |
| `--default-credential` | string | Shared default credential |
| `--tools` | list | Enabled tools |
| `--max-rows` | int | Most rows per call |

Local or remote.

### `workspace disable`

Disable a workspace.

```text
agility-bridge workspace disable <workspace-id>
```

| Name | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `<workspace-id>` | argument | Workspace id |

Local or remote.

### `workspace delete`

Delete a workspace, its grants and their tokens.

```text
agility-bridge workspace delete <workspace-id>
```

| Name | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `<workspace-id>` | argument | Workspace id |

Local or remote.

## grant

### `grant list`

List grants.

```text
agility-bridge grant list [--workspace <value>]
```

| Name | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--workspace` | string | Only this workspace |

Local or remote.

### `grant add`

Grant a user (--user) or a labelled service (--service) access to a workspace.

```text
agility-bridge grant add --workspace <value> [--user <value>] [--service <value>] [--credential <value>] [--tools a,b] [--project <value>] [--expires-days <value>]
```

| Name | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--workspace` | string, required | Workspace id |
| `--user` | string | User id |
| `--service` | string | Label of a service grant (read-only) |
| `--credential` | string | Credential (default: the workspace's shared default) |
| `--tools` | list | Only these tools |
| `--project` | string, repeatable | Only these of the workspace projects (repeat) |
| `--expires-days` | string | Days until it expires, or `never` |

Local or remote.

### `grant revoke`

Revoke a grant (and so all its tokens).

```text
agility-bridge grant revoke <grant-id>
```

| Name | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `<grant-id>` | argument | Grant id |

Local or remote.

### `grant delete`

Delete a grant and its tokens.

```text
agility-bridge grant delete <grant-id>
```

| Name | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `<grant-id>` | argument | Grant id |

Local or remote.

## audit

### `audit tail`

Show the newest audit rows (oldest first).

```text
agility-bridge audit tail [--limit <n>] [--kind <value>] [--workspace <value>]
```

| Name | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--limit` | int | How many (default 20, at most 1000) |
| `--kind` | string | `tool_call`, `auth`, `admin` or `write` |
| `--workspace` | string | Only this workspace id |

Local or remote.

## keys

### `keys status`

Credentials per master-key version (local).

```text
agility-bridge keys status
```

Local database only.

### `keys rotate`

Re-encrypt stored tokens with the current master key; resumable (local).

```text
agility-bridge keys rotate --reason <value>
```

| Name | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--reason` | string, required | Why, for the audit log |

Local database only.

### `keys retire`

Retire a master-key version no credential uses any more (local).

```text
agility-bridge keys retire <version> --reason <value>
```

| Name | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `<version>` | argument | Key version, e.g. 1 |
| `--reason` | string, required | Why, for the audit log |

Local database only.
